Part 1 - Short instruction: A woman from image0 and image1, wearing a yellow top and a layered blue skirt, is standing in front of an elegant European-style café. She leans toward the camera to showcase a sweet smile, then leans back to reveal her upper body. Later, she performs fluid dance movements including placing her hands on her hips, flipping her hair, and spinning to display her outfit and figure, while passersby add a touch of realism to the background.

Part 2 - Long instruction: Generate a video where the woman from image0 and image1 is standing in front of a charming European-style café with a cream-colored facade, large windows, hanging plants, and a vintage bicycle parked nearby. The scene is warmly lit with soft daylight filtering through the surrounding trees. She is dressed in a pastel yellow fitted top and a flowing blue layered skirt with soft ruffles, paired with casual beige shoes. Her long wavy black hair cascades over her shoulders, and she accessorizes with a delicate choker necklace and a pendant chain.

At the start of the video, the woman leans forward slightly toward the camera with a cheerful and sweet smile, creating an intimate and engaging moment. She then straightens up and gently leans backward to give a clear view of her upper body and outfit. After that, she transitions into a series of graceful dance movements: placing her hands on her hips, flipping her hair in a playful motion, turning to the side to showcase her profile, and performing a smooth spin that highlights the flow of her skirt and her figure. Throughout the video, pedestrians occasionally walk by in the background, adding a lively and authentic touch to the café setting.
